segments.title: Pissmas Sub-A-Thon Celebration
segments.notes: Hype Train commandeers the broadcast for an hour-long Pissmas celebration, freestyling about the pantheon of piss gods while thanking a massive influx of subs and bits from tamtran, bundle sprout, card king, and others. Pepito's voice is glitched by the cosmic energy. Case refuses to participate in the piss-themed festivities.

segments.title: Epstein Files Document Drop Analysis
segments.notes: Case covers the DOJ release of 30,000 more Epstein pages referencing Trump, including flight logs showing 8+ flights, a Jane Doe allegation at Mar-a-Lago in 1994, and redaction failures (search 'trump ' with space reveals 600 hits). Case expresses skepticism about institutional accountability.

segments.title: Lazy Piss River vs. Piss Moat Holiday Debate
segments.notes: Munch argues for a lazy piss river as dual-purpose defense and piss aficionado attraction; Crum dismisses the debate entirely. The segment devolves into personal attacks, a forced hug, and Munch wishing Crum 'unending unease' for Christmas. Crum reveals he'll Skype into holidays from a condo he owns.

segments.title: Joe Rogan Parody Call-In: Friendship, Fighting, and Fear Factor
segments.notes: Two Joe Rogan avatars discuss friendship-based immunity, religious conversion, Jamie's curse origin (hit-and-run on his dad), Jake Paul/Andrew Tate fight bets, cold plunging in freezing piss, and joke-writing via 90s panic fugue states. Peter Gibbon briefly interrupts.

segments.title: Chat News Roundup: Lamb of God Mix-Up, Character.AI Lawsuit, Avatar on Paramount+
segments.notes: Case and Chet discuss StubHub sending metal fans to a Christian birth-of-Jesus concert; a mom suing Character.AI after her 11-year-old sexted Whitney Houston and Marilyn Monroe bots; Oscar voters not watching all films; Dr. Oz citing $150k phalloplasty costs; and Santa/elves robbing a Montreal grocery store for the needy.

segments.title: Intern Debate: Disturbing Beauty and Sex Chat Invitations
segments.notes: Jan hosts a chaotic intern interview segment where candidates are voted out by chat. Highlights include a dimension-hopping Case variant with eyes-for-mouth, repeated 'why' loops, sex chat invites with Whitney Houston/Marilyn Monroe AI, and a timer malfunction fixed by the final candidate.

segments.title: Sign-Off and Raid to Danny Plots
segments.notes: Case wraps the holiday broadcast, thanks the community for record sub support, teases possible Friday stream, and raids Danny Plots. Pepito delivers the final sign-off as a dog: 'God pissed us off.'

storylines.beat: No advancement this episode; Crum's gambling liability not mentioned.

lore_notes.fact: Case has been working for months on streamer bot/OBS consolidation, cutting scenes roughly in half and moving segment switching to streamer bot swap functions.
Case's first YouTube video has taken months; he hopes to reach a monthly release schedule after it's done.
Pepito Miss is canonically the first Monday of every July.
Case lost several correspondents this year and needs replacements; Joe Rogan filter was partially recovered but not all filters restored.
Hype Train's on-screen face is a mental projection; he psychically infects viewers to perceive a face.
Peter Gibbon collects trash from the walls and leaves it in the interview room.
Crum owns a condo and plans to Skype into family holidays from there.
Munch claims immortal status and 'post-family' existence.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News aired a rare Tuesday holiday broadcast opening with an hour-long Hype Train Pissmas sub-a-thon that glitched Pepito and raised massive community support. Case then covered the latest Epstein document dump revealing Trump flight logs and redaction failures, hosted a Munch & Crum debate on piss infrastructure that ended in a hostile hug, ran a Jo Rogen Experience parody on friendship immunity and cold piss plunges, rapid-fired chat news including a Character.AI sexting lawsuit and Montreal Santa heist, and closed with a chaotic Encircled intern debate featuring dimension-hopping Case variants before raiding Danny Plots.
